MOD/01Free · open source · no telemetry

The fast, private browser that stays out of your way.

Krunk is a Chromium-based browser for Windows 10 and 11: ads and trackers blocked out of the box, an encrypted password vault, end-to-end encrypted sync and nothing phoning home.

Download for Windows Read the changelog

Windows 10 and 11 · x64 · Android preview · No telemetry · Privacy

01Features

Everything you need, nothing you don't

A bundled Chromium engine with the privacy settings already on, a vault and sync that only you can read, and the tools power users expect — without accounts, ads or telemetry.

  • Ads and trackers blocked

    uBlock Origin's filter lists and scriptlets are built in, YouTube included. The shield shows what was stopped.

  • No telemetry

    Krunk talks to no server of its own except the daily filter-list and update checks. Nothing about your browsing leaves your PC. The optional AI agent talks only to the AI provider you set up yourself.

  • A vault for your passwords

    Logins and cards encrypted behind your master password, with a password generator and autofill.

  • Sync you can't be read from

    Bookmarks, history, tabs, settings and passwords, encrypted on your devices before upload. Optional, with a free account (beta).

  • Quick with many tabs

    Background tabs are throttled like Chrome's and go to sleep, so the tab you're on stays fast.

  • Video and games work

    A bundled Chromium engine with H.264 and AAC, picture-in-picture, pointer lock and full screen. No Edge, no WebView2.

  • An AI agent, only if you want one

    Off until you turn it on. Bring your own key (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic or a local model) and tell it what to do on the page. It never sees your passwords or cards, and Stop ends it at once.

  • Userscripts and macros

    Tampermonkey-style userscripts and small key-and-click macros with hotkeys, in a built-in code editor. No AI needed.

  • Extensions from the Chrome Web Store

    "Add to Krunk" on a store page installs many Manifest V3 extensions, checked against their signatures, with their permissions shown first.

02Privacy

Private by default

The settings that protect you are already on. You can change them, but you don't have to.

  • Third-party cookies blocked
  • Tracking parameters stripped from links
  • Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control sent
  • Cookie and site-data manager
  • Private windows that leave nothing behind
  • Updates checked with signatures, installed only when you say so

03Questions

What does the AI agent send, and where?

Nothing until you turn on AI features and add a provider with your own key. Then the page content the agent works on, and your messages, go from Krunk straight to that provider (Krunk runs no AI service of its own). Your history, bookmarks, downloads and cookies go only when you ask for them in words and click Allow. Passwords, payment cards, the vault, sync data and your API keys never do; your key is stored encrypted on your PC.

Is Krunk free?

Yes. Krunk is open source under the MIT licence, with no ads and nothing to buy.

Do I need an account?

No. Krunk works fully without one. An account is only needed to sync between your devices.

What does it need?

Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit, and about 450 MB of disk space once installed. The Android preview needs Android 8 or later on a 64-bit ARM phone or tablet.

Where is my data?

On your PC, in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Krunk. Passwords are encrypted with your master password; with sync on, your data is encrypted before it leaves the PC.

KruxSYS

Krunk is a KruxSYS product: a fast, private browser for Windows, with a preview for Android. Open source (MIT), no telemetry.

Bundles Chromium through the Chromium Embedded Framework, and filter lists by EasyList and uBlock Origin; see the notices in the download.
